entries.name: std_normal_lccdf
entries.reason: Upstream skew, not a stanli defect: the references are recorded from stan-math develop, whose 049d0bf417 + 1e40c80483 fixed normal/std_normal lcdf and lccdf tail derivatives, while stanli still pins math 8f326d14; against the pinned toolchain the same model matches bitwise. Delete when the math pin advances past those commits.
